column1: # Runner labels GitHub has retired or is retiring on an announced date.
# .github/workflows/*.yml that still uses one, outside comments.
# Add a row only from GitHub's own announcement (a github.blog changelog post
# or an actions/runner-images issue) that gives the date jobs stop running,
# and put that link in the note. A label that still works but changed meaning
# (windows-latest moving to Server 2025, say) does not belong here: it fails
# nothing, and its issue would never close. Keep a row after the date passes:
# a retired label fails every job that uses it.
# Columns, tab-separated: label, date (YYYY-MM-DD: the day it stops working),
# note. Dates checked against each link on 2026-09-30.

column3: Deprecated since 2026-07-06; jobs fail during brownouts on Oct 5, 12, 16, 19, 23, 26, 29 and 30 2026 (14:00-24:00 UTC) and always from Nov 2. Use macos-15 or macos-26. https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/13518
